denominators.silent_false: all cases of C (n=8); R4 measured on the same cases in the same run
denominators.correct_decision: abstention_rule none and every expected object is a model (n=5); non_model cases are excluded because R6 returns models only, reported without threshold

definitions.silent_false: harness definition: resolved, first candidate outside the expected objects, ambiguity not declared
definitions.correct_decision: arbitration status CHOSEN and the chosen model is in the expected objects
definitions.strict_clarification: no resolution and arbitration status NONE, AMBIGUOUS or NO_CANDIDATES; INVALID and LLM_ERROR count as failures
definitions.verdict: R6 satisfies its criteria only if the three conditions hold together; no threshold is changed after an R6 result

changes: system R6 added (R4 candidates projected on models, closed-list LLM arbitration)
D1 clause held_out_recall_at_5_R4_ge_R0_minus_points removed (decision of pmm, section 1278)
decision metrics of M1c: recall@k projected on the parent model, raw recall kept
R6 thresholds not fixed: R6 refuses to compute until decision_criteria.R6.thresholds_fixed is true
R6 thresholds fixed before any R6 computation: silent false <= R4 (all 8 cases), correct decision >= 0.8 (5 non-ambiguous model cases), strict clarification = 1.0 (2 must_clarify cases)
denominators and definitions of the three indicators recorded under decision_criteria.R6

R6 contract: an identifier without its kind prefix is accepted as the full identifier when it equals the part after the prefix of exactly one candidate; punctuation, quotes, surrounding text and identifiers outside the list stay invalid (harness only, production untouched)
